grain: one overall row (breakdown_value='ALL') plus one row per risk_segment

delinquent_loan_count.business_definition: Distinct loans with at least one delinquency_events row.
delinquent_loan_count.formula: count(distinct loan_id in delinquency_events, restricted to this group's loans)

delinquency_rate.business_definition: Share of loans in this group that are delinquent.

default_count.business_definition: Loans in this group that defaulted.
default_count.formula: count(defaults, restricted to this group's loans)

default_rate.business_definition: Share of loans in this group that defaulted.
caveats: Answers 'what is the default rate by risk tier?' via the per-risk_segment rows.

total_balance_at_default.business_definition: Total outstanding balance at the moment of default across this group's defaulted loans.
total_balance_at_default.formula: sum(defaults.balance_at_default, restricted to this group's loans)

total_recovery_amount.business_definition: Total amount recovered after default across this group.
total_recovery_amount.formula: sum(defaults.recovery_amount, restricted to this group's loans)

recovery_rate.business_definition: Share of defaulted balance ultimately recovered.

loss_rate.business_definition: Net loss (unrecovered defaulted balance) as a fraction of total funded principal for this group.
caveats: Denominator is business_rules.loss_rate_denominator (currently total_funded_principal, a portfolio-level loss rate) -- NOT total_balance_at_default (which would be a loss-given-default rate, a different valid convention). Answers 'what is the default rate by risk tier?' and related loss questions via the per-risk_segment rows.
